title: Perfectness of supported open pushforward
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, and T a closed subset of X contained in U. A perfect derived module F on U [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T has perfect R(U.ι)_*F [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: On U, derived direct image restricts to F; on V = X minus T it is the derived direct image of the zero restriction on U intersect V. Thus it is zero on V.
Perfectness is defined by local strictly perfect models. Combine the local models of F on U with the zero strictly perfect model on V, since U and V cover X.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_open_pushforward_perfect (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    (∀ F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme, IsPerfect U.toScheme F →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj F).val.presheaf
            x))) →
      IsPerfect X ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj F))
